create_hotpotqa_dataset: create a HotpotQADataset instance to convert HotpotQA data into KILT format with knowledge store lookup
get_chunks_hotpotqa: call get_chunks on HotpotQADataset to split the input JSON file into N equal chunks for processing
process_chunk_hotpotqa: process a chunk of HotpotQA datapoints into KILT records with Wikipedia provenance and BLEU matching
postprocess_metadata_hotpotqa: postprocess chunk metadata to aggregate missing pages, exact match, and fuzzy match statistics
review_hotpotqa_dataset_class: review the HotpotQADataset class and its methods for converting HotpotQA to KILT format
